verdict.rationale: Autumn publishes an API reference covering core endpoints: track, attach, previewAttach, multiAttach, createSchedule, openCustomerPortal, import and attachLicense, plus SDK examples for check and track. It also has an atomic check-and-reserve call, an `atmn api` command that calls any public endpoint from the terminal, and an llms.txt index for agents. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product end to end via the API.
